description: This file defines an abstract class 'StreamSubscriptionHandle<T>' which represents a handle for a stream subscription in Orleans streaming framework. It includes properties for stream identification, provider name, handle ID, and methods for unsubscribing and resuming subscriptions.

classes.name: StreamSubscriptionHandle<T>
classes.description: An abstract class representing a handle for a stream subscription, allowing operations like unsubscribe and resume.

methods.name: UnsubscribeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously unsubscribes the consumer from the stream.

methods.name: ResumeAsync (IAsyncObserver<T> observer, StreamSequenceToken token = null)
methods.description: Resumes consumption from a stream subscription with a specific observer and optional sequence token.

methods.name: ResumeAsync (IAsyncBatchObserver<T> observer, StreamSequenceToken token = null)
methods.description: Resumes batch consumption from a stream subscription with a batch observer and optional sequence token.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Determines whether this handle is equal to another handle.
